methodology.micro: Three fresh off processes, three warmups and nine measured samples per case/process; one separately observed process, same cases, nine samples. Timings include performance.now brackets/assertions equally. No benchmark overlaps a suite or another experiment.
methodology.passes: hydrate counts equal full canonical validation passes; hydratedNodes counts completed structural visits; validationVisits separately includes early rejection visits. dehydrate counts are canonical serialization-to-envelope passes, not JSON.stringify calls. Both perform M copyEnvelope shape/JSON copies per M edits and M+1 dehydrates (2M for M individual setters). After avoids only the last commit hydration when there is a successful candidate; zero-success commits still hydrate.
methodology.baseline: Actual unmodified Spike H canonical adapter and Page at b82a980; candidate differs only in the server canonical adapter. Both captured under identical probe source and observer settings, in sequential fresh processes.
methodology.hotControl: Three fresh processes; twenty alternating warmups and 27 measured pairs for each case. H helper body loaded from its archived source with import relocation only; both paths use the same runtime modules in the same process. No hooks.
methodology.http: Three fresh windows per mode/provider; SQLite serial existing/attributed, concurrency-12 existing/attributed/off; JSON concurrency-12 attributed. Existing Spike G bounded supervisor/harness, separate client, 1,000 ms Page deadline. Sequential before/after, no reliability inference from micro speed.

exclusions: First extended fixture omitted required block content; fixed before retained captures.

Second extended attempt exhausted the existing deadline in the 69-node two-Page microcase; reduced concurrent semantic fixture to seven nodes. No limits changed. Aborted attempts emitted no complete timing capture; their failure logs are preserved.
limitations: No OS isolation proof from mocks; installed Linux boundary tests are separately recorded.
Host scheduling/load, filesystem, GC and warmup variance remain. Inclusive synchronous spans overlap and cannot be summed as CPU.
Micro contexts have no installed lifetime guard. Their live context checks are counted, not a package-integrity qualification.
Only the two server Page edit sites are optimized. Shared controller, systemSet, package mutation and portable/client edits retain their previous passes.
Observer overhead is reported separately; attributed HTTP absolute timings are perturbed. Failed Pages perform unequal work.
No production deployment, browser manual, hostile-root filesystem, power-loss or network-filesystem qualification.
